title: 3 Martins vs 1 Move
summary: Martin gets three moves for each one of Tony's, with check ending Martin's turn early. Tony manually resets positions so three Martin moves appear after each of his. Strategy: develop one piece at a time and grab material. After ~17 min he loses when he takes a rook off the back rank and Martin promotes, ending with Qc2+ then Qg2# (~16:20).
rules: Bot makes 3 consecutive moves, player makes 1.
If the bot gives check during its sequence, its turn ends immediately.
win_condition: Checkmate Martin (goal: win one game; Tony lost in the video).
